── bwrap ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(this argv determines the network posture on its own: --unshare-net creates
 the sandbox's own empty network namespace, so running it by hand reproduces
 it.)
bwrap
  --ro-bind /usr /usr
  -- /bin/sh
(argv[0] is the bare name "bwrap" and snug does not exec that name: it calls
 exec.LookPath("bwrap") against the HOST user's own $PATH at the moment the
 run starts, and execs the absolute path that search returns. WHICH bwrap runs
 is therefore a fact about that $PATH then — a directory earlier on it than
 /usr/bin chooses the binary, after this artifact has said everything it has
 to say. Settle it by hand with: command -v bwrap)
